smallText.fixture: 3200x1800 white canvas, black monospace 12/16/24/36 px text; same logical drawing on each host. Platform font rasterization differs.
smallText.inspectionMethod: Pillow losslessly cropped original output pixels without resize. Viewed PNG crops 1:1; crop rectangles and hashes below allow reproduction from output bytes. No upscaling or OCR claims.

smallText.metricMeaning: darkInkFraction = pixels with arithmetic mean RGB <=64 divided by pixels <245 in the 12px line crop. This measures loss of dark stroke contrast only, not recognition accuracy.
findings: 1536 turns a 12px source font into 5.76 output pixels; 2048 turns it into 7.68. Both lose fine strokes, even where known text can still be guessed.
3072 produces 11.52px effective text and is clearer than 2048, but iOS resampling remains visibly softer than unscaled 3200.
3200 preserves the full tested 12px glyph size and gives the clearest small text on both hosts.
The user-facing provider image must not silently reuse a thumbnail or unconditionally downscale text-bearing screenshots to 2048.

recommendation.scope: Original small-text candidate; subsequent dual-host single and 8-image 48MP resource checks confirmed the bounded engineering policy, now adopted by SDD. See resource-host-analysis.md/json; production integration remains separate.
recommendation.preview: Separate preview size from model-send and formal-note variants.
recommendation.preserveNativePixels: Do not resize source images already within the 3200 longest-edge candidate; use pixel re-encoding for metadata policy.
recommendation.textImages: Treat text/screenshot detail as essential. Do not select 2048 solely to reduce bytes. If a larger input must be reduced, the limit does not prove text preservation; expose a clear request for a smaller region or compatible original rather than claiming complete detail.
recommendation.budgetFailure: Retain original and draft; enforce separate per-image and per-request byte budgets. Do not silently lower resolution past the text requirement to fit.
recommendation.photo2048: Optional only where text/detail preservation is not required; not a universal default.
recommendation.formalNote: Use a separate note-purpose export, not the provider-budget or thumbnail variant.

limits: No actual model OCR or visual reasoning request was sent; provider-side downsampling can still lose detail.

This report tests exact 3200 edge on a 5.76MP screenshot; original 12/24/48MP ladders tested up to3072. Subsequent 3200 single and 8-image 48MP resource checks are recorded separately in resource-host-analysis.md/json and do not expand the small-text sample.
No claim of preserving all small text in images wider than3200; no universal automatic text detection was tested.

qualityPolicyConstraint: Integrity, metadata and small synthetic charts pass. Small-text evidence explicitly does not support unconditional2048 shrinking; provider policy must preserve source pixels within tested3200 bound or honestly recover when detail cannot be retained.
